reply_text:
Opening the Recode transcript and the 2018 Dota blog post.I found no dated AI prediction from Sam Altman made in 2018. That's because my search was cut short, though: I didn't check the year thoroughly and confirm it was empty. The three fixed searches all ran, and every result was from 2021 to 2026 coverage.

- **Main 2018 source, cut off:** the best 2018 source I found was Recode's full transcript of his live interview with Kara Swisher at Manny's in San Francisco, published 10 December 2018. The intro says the talk covered "the future of artificial intelligence". But the page text I got stops in the middle of a sentence, during the Facebook section, before that part. In the text I could read, his only AI line looks back rather than forward: he skipped running for governor because he wanted "to make sure we get artificial intelligence built in a really good way."
- **Pages that didn't help:** his blog's feed only returned posts from 2025–2026. A copy of the Recode transcript on another site was blocked. A 25 June 2018 blog post on OpenAI's Dota 2 result appeared only in a search snippet, so I don't quote it.
- **Budget used up:** my 12th search was stopped by the usage limit, so I used all 12 searches and 3 of the 6 page openings (one of which failed). One of my searches didn't run in my first attempt, which cost a call before I re-ran it. "quiet_year" is true under your rule, but that reflects how little I could check, not proof that he made no predictions that year.

Worth checking next: the Recode transcript under the same path on vox.com, and his 2018 blog posts and talks by name.
